name: copilot-mcp
description: MCP server exposing EHR Copilot tools: prod->pre-prod order clone, queue-item build, and UiPath Orchestrator execution analysis
long_description:
Exposes EHR Copilot order operations and UiPath Orchestrator execution analysis as MCP tools and prompts. Covers reading and cloning Copilot orders (prod -> pre-prod only, never mutating prod), building/posting UiPath queue items against a pre-prod dev clone, diagnosing job runs and stuck orders, and an additive prod -> pre-prod settings sync.

Requires a config file (see `copilot-mcp.config.example.json` bundled alongside this manifest) with Copilot BE credentials per profile and UiPath Orchestrator credentials — point the "Config file" option below at your copy of it.

config_path.title: Config file
config_path.description: Path to your copilot-mcp.config.json (Copilot BE creds per profile + UiPath Orchestrator creds). See copilot-mcp.config.example.json bundled alongside this manifest for the exact shape.
